metadata.description: A marketplace of Claude Code plugins for Midnight developer-relations and ecosystem maintenance. Ships midnight-docs-drift (detects and repairs documentation that has drifted behind the code it describes), midnight-relnotes (release note detection and generation), midnight-reports (generates self-contained HTML pull-request activity reports for any GitHub repo), midnight-tutorial-checker (walks a tutorial as reader personas and reports where each kind of reader gets stuck), and gha (full-lifecycle GitHub Actions workflow tooling).
